## Pull Request Checklist
Please ensure that your PR fulfills the following requirements:

- [ ] The PR title and commit messages are clear and descriptive.
- [ ] The project builds successfully without warnings.
- [ ] Tests have been added or updated where appropriate.
- [ ] For bugfixes, regression tests fail without the fix.
- [ ] Existing tests pass.
- [ ] Changes have been tested locally and the game behaves as expected.
- [ ] Visual changes have been checked in-game, where applicable.
- [ ] C++ code has been formatted using ClangFormat (`make clangformat`).

<!--- When using AI-assisted development tools, please ensure that:
- You understand and have thoroughly reviewed all submitted code.
- AI-generated comments have been reviewed for correctness and usefulness.
- Comments referring to prompts, previous AI iterations, or other irrelevant context have been removed.
- Comments explain non-obvious implementation details rather than simply narrating the code.
The same standards apply to AI-generated and manually written code. -->
